note.original: Your digestive enzymes can break down just about any organic material into food. You eject a spray of digestive enzymes in a @Template[type:cone|distance:20], dealing @Damage[(ceil(@actor.level/2)+1)d6[acid]|options:area-damage] damage plus 1d6 acid damage for every 2 levels beyond 9th (to a maximum of 11d6 at 19th level), with a @Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic|options:area-effect,damaging-effect] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. The digestive slurry remains liquid for 1 hour. As long as at least one living creature in the cone failed its saving throw, the slurry contains nutrients that you can absorb to restore your body. If you spend 10 minutes absorbing the liquid slurry through your roots, you regain @Damage[(@actor.level*6)[healing]] Hit Points equal to 6 times your level.
note.final: ⟦X000⟧你的消化酶几乎能将任何有机物分解为食物。你喷出一片⟦X001⟧的消化酶，造成⟦X002⟧伤害，且9级之后每2级额外造成1d6酸蚀伤害（19级时至多11d6），进行一次⟦X003⟧豁免，对抗你的职业DC或法术DC中较高者。消化浆液在1小时内保持液态。只要锥形范围内至少一个活物豁免失败，浆液就含有可供你吸收、恢复肉体的营养。如果你花费10分钟用根系吸收浆液，你恢复⟦X004⟧生命值，等于自身等级的6倍。⟦X005⟧
